@(Look out though!)
@(If an enemy catches you from behind then the spinny swirl will be red.)
@(Then they get an opening attack on you!)
@(You should always try to have the advantage when fighting.)

@(All this talk of swirly spinny swirls is making me dizzy...)
@Chirp[13][02]
